county_volume_formula: N_c=historical_state_all_candidate_volume * (mix_year_county_all_named / mix_year_state_all_named); T_c=N_c*(mix_year_county_pair / mix_year_county_all_named). Preference independently uses named A/(A+B) of preference year.
native_formula: Only2024 authority+literal precinct recorded pair weights; low/base/high pair and all-candidate statewide totals from named historical contests, proportionally scaled over original2024pair weights. Historical preference remains2024. Four administrative-only contexts have no assigned pair pool; no absent named vote is relabeled observed0.
legal_outcome: Strict plurality of all named candidates; tie/+1 A-B arithmetic alone does not establish an election winner. Other named candidate vote shares held at mix-year statewide totals in county scenarios, and volume-anchor statewide totals in native scenarios, as explicit historical-only assumptions.
others_selected_only_assumption: Every other unit fixed at that model baseline share and expected volume, zero additional share shift; no priority filter.
